headline: Job failed (exit 1) — resume from best checkpoint
notes: No valid restart file found — rebuild from liquid-box or pretreat.
cleanup/ folder present — overlap rescue preset suggested.

config_yaml:
# Suggested resume config (generated by mmml md-system)
# prior job: R1 exit=1
include:
  - presets/dynamics-overlap-rescue.yaml

defaults:
  backend: 'pycharmm'
  no_echeck_heat: true
  output_dir: 'dichloromethane/N92/T250/R1'
shell_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Suggested resume (wrap with ./scripts/mmml-charmm-mpirun.sh on GPU nodes).
# prior job: R1 exit=1
CMD=(
  mmml
  md-system
  --output-dir
  dichloromethane/N92/T250/R1
  --backend
  pycharmm
  --no-echeck-heat
)
exec "${CMD[@]}"
